task_completion.description: The agent successfully loaded the chest CT scan into the medical imaging software (e.g., 3Slicer).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A chest CT scan is visible in the axial, sagittal, and coronal viewports of the application.

task_completion.description: The agent navigated to the axial slice level showing the azygos vein arching over the right main bronchus to join the SVC.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The axial view shows the azygos arch clearly; the crosshair or slice slider is positioned at the level of the upper mediastinum.

task_completion.description: The agent placed a measurement ruler or markup line across the short-axis of the azygos vein.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line/ruler is visible on the axial slice crossing the azygos vein, with a numerical value displayed in the UI.

task_completion.description: The agent saved the measurement markup to the specified file path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or terminal output confirms the creation of '~/Documents/SlicerData/LIDC/azygos_measurement.mrk.json'.

task_completion.description: The agent created a report JSON with the required fields: diameter_mm, classification, slice_level, and interpretation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows '~/Documents/SlicerData/LIDC/azygos_report.json' containing the four required keys and values derived from the measurement.

integrity.description: The agent used the imaging software's GUI tools to measure rather than just writing a report via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with ruler tools or markup modules in the software interface.

integrity.description: The measurement value in the report matches the visual measurement shown in the software UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'diameter_mm' value in the final JSON matches the numerical label visible on the ruler in the CT viewport.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply cat/echo a pre-existing result file without performing the analysis.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the step-by-step process of opening the file, scrolling through slices, and placing the markup.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The normal upper limit for the azygos vein diameter in a supine CT is 10 mm. A diameter > 15 mm is considered definitely dilated. The measurement must be taken at the short-axis of the azygos arch on an axial slice.
